ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails of recent fraud cases in Minnesota, including Feeding Our Future and the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie.
questions: What are the financial connections between the suspects and the victims?
How are the suspects laundering their money?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money will reveal a larger network of fraudsters and help to uncover the truth behind these cases.
